data_class_note: Result numbers in this example are SYNTHETIC fixtures generated by make_fixtures.py. The expected-support matrix they are diffed against is REAL data transcribed from AWS documentation. Nothing here is a measurement.
scenario: A customer on emr-7.11.0 with Lake Formation FGAC wants to move to emr-7.13.0. The upgrade crosses the 7.12 boundary where DML/DDL switch from runtime-role credentials to LF vended credentials, and the 7.10 boundary where Delta/Hudi Spark configuration changes. They also want to know what FGAC costs them versus FTA and versus plain Glue, and to validate a candidate patch.

variants.label: 7.11.0 FGAC (current)
variants.notes: Pre-7.12: DML/DDL that modify table data use runtime-role credentials. DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE unsupported under FGAC. Pre-7.10 config style not required (7.11 >= 7.10).

variants.label: 7.13.0 FGAC (candidate)
variants.notes: Post-7.12: DML/DDL that modify table data use LF vended credentials. DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE supported.

variants.label: 7.13.0 FTA
variants.notes: Separate application: FTA and FGAC cannot coexist on one EMR Serverless application or EMR cluster.

variants.label: 7.13.0 plain Glue
variants.notes: The control. Runtime-role IAM credentials, no LF filtering.

variants.label: 7.13.0 FGAC + candidate patch
